#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
python3 - "$@" <<'PY'
import re,sys
from pathlib import Path
template,values,out=map(Path,sys.argv[1:4])
mapping=dict(line.split('\t',1) for line in values.read_text().splitlines())
text=template.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
if any(k not in mapping for k in re.findall(r'\{\{([A-Z_]+)\}\}',text)):sys.exit(2)
result=re.sub(r'\{\{([A-Z_]+)\}\}',lambda m:mapping[m[1]],text)
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);out.write_bytes(result.encode('utf-8'))
PY
